editorialAssessment.narrative: Supported concrete actions, household comedy, pursuit and suspense carry the text. Sophie bargains, interferes, travels and performs the decisive rescue. No managerial/moral lecture or invented dialogue found.
editorialAssessment.novelDistinctions: Martha/Lettie exchange, Michael, Welsh Howell, male Suliman/composite bodies and Witch-versus-fire-demon distinction retained. No film war, bird transformation, kiss restoration or film time-travel ending found.
editorialAssessment.uncertainty: Howl’s explanation of Sophie sustaining her disguise remains attributed. Her renewed youth is shown without asserting a single psychological mechanism. Angorian’s fiancé/capture claims remain claims. The actual romance and Calcifer’s freedom are retained without a fabricated permanent guarantee.
editorialAssessment.lateMechanisms: Specific chapter-21 event blocks and the second guide were read; actual Jones rescue/heart-object/return quotations were checked separately. No whole-book continuous-read prerequisite was imposed.

requiredFindings.exactRU: Софи собирается уйти предупредить Летти, но снаружи появляется знакомое пугало — теперь оно скачет вслед за замком.
requiredFindings.exactEN: Sophie means to leave and warn Lettie, but the familiar scarecrow appears outside, now hopping after the castle.
requiredFindings.reason: This is the chapter-7 scarecrow chase, when Sophie still believes Howl is courting Martha under Lettie’s appearance. Michael explains the two different Letties later that evening. The candidate moves that explanation into the preceding screen and then changes the sister Sophie means to warn. It gives the chase a different established motive; this is not a preference about how much detail to retain.

smallestSupportedCorrection.instruction: Keep this screen and its sources/counts. Replace its opening with a brief retrospective clause identifying Martha; retain the remainder of the chase. A name substitution alone would leave the knowledge sequence confusing after two-letties.
smallestSupportedCorrection.ru: Раньше, ещё думая, что Хаул ухаживает за Мартой, Софи собралась уйти предупредить её, но снаружи появилось знакомое пугало — оно скакало вслед за замком.
smallestSupportedCorrection.en: Earlier, still thinking Howl was courting Martha, Sophie had tried to leave and warn her, but the familiar scarecrow appeared outside, hopping after the castle.

evidence.locator: Opening event blocks: Sophie cannot go that night to warn Martha; next morning the scarecrow stops her. Later-day event block: Michael returns from Cesari’s and explains the different Letties. Web line locators 129–150 and 166; no verified print page.
Chapter 7 Summary: worry about Martha, scarecrow chase, then Michael’s evening return and clarification.

requiredFindings.exactRU: После смерти отца мачеха Фанни распределяет девушек в ученицы
requiredFindings.exactEN: After their father dies, their stepmother Fanny arranges apprenticeships
requiredFindings.reason: The English collective possessive makes Fanny stepmother to all three sisters. She is Sophie’s and Lettie’s stepmother but Martha’s birth mother. The Russian clause has no collective possessive and can remain as Sophie-focal narration.

smallestSupportedCorrection.en: After their father dies, Sophie’s stepmother Fanny arranges apprenticeships

editionAndAccessLimits: No complete primary edition was read continuously or obtained by this reviewer. No published Russian translation was checked. This is a review of the retained condensation, not certification of omitted chapters, all original wording or a whole edition.
Chapter references are work-level locators. LitCharts/SuperSummary pagination was not verified against ISBN 9780007380459 and is not asserted as print-page evidence.

Direct LitCharts chapter 9 timed out. Direct chapters 12, 14–19 returned JavaScript/robot challenges on the attempts made. Only actually returned public guide/quotation/indexed blocks were used; no locked or pseudo-Latin placeholder text, teacher questions or challenge bypass was used.

The independent substitute for the unavailable chapter-9/12/14–19 pages was the substantial public SuperSummary 9–12, 13–16 and 17–21 event accounts, together with the actual quoted Jones anchors. Public indexed chapter-14/15 event blocks were additionally read.

The implementer’s 216-OPF local-search claim and library-record access claim were read in its ledger but not independently repeated. The library record was not used as plot evidence. No unrelated private listings were inspected.

No independent browser or physical iPhone/PWA run was performed. DOM-stub execution checks reader branching, not layout or Safari behaviour. Existing writer browser claims are not being relabelled as this reviewer’s tests.
